title: Accountable AI Delegation in Banking: Identity, Commitment Controls, Decision Evidence and Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.27505v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An AI-assisted payment can pass assessment and lose release authority before commitment. We specify a banking delegation contract that checks current authority, the shared payment cap and the capacity of eligible instruments to cover losses. It books the new payment and its recovery demands and writes the outcome record in the same atomic transition. A paired example identifies the authorised mandate, applied rule and selection inputs a reviewer needs to assess mandate conformance. We show that, under fixed resource inputs, the transition preserves the payment cap and recovery feasibility when commitments and effective withdrawals are ordered against the same authoritative state. Reversing a transmitted priority changes the selected route in 4 of 32 distinct behavioural combinations, represented by 96 of 576 labelled contexts. translated_title: 银行业中可问责的AI委托：身份、承诺控制、决策证据与追偿
translated_abstract: 一笔AI辅助的支付可能在通过评估后、在承诺（commitment）之前失去放行权限。我们规定了一种银行委托合同，用于检查当前权限、共享支付上限以及合格工具覆盖损失的能力。它在同一原子转换中登记新支付及其追偿请求，并写入结果记录。一个配对示例识别出审查者评估委托合规性所需的授权委托、适用规则和选择输入。我们证明，在固定资源输入下，当承诺和有效提款针对同一权威状态进行排序时，该转换能够保持支付上限和追偿可行性。反转所传输的优先级会在32种不同行为组合中的4种（对应576个标记上下文中的96个）中改变所选路线。执行器在所有这些情况下都遵循所传输的规则。重用较早的状态会在123个历史……中允许23次放行（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种银行AI委托合同规范，通过原子转换同步检查权限、共享支付上限与损失覆盖能力并登记追偿请求，证明在有序资源状态下该转换能保持支付上限与追偿可行性，并通过配对示例为审查者提供评估AI决策合规性所需的决策证据。
en_tdlr: This paper specifies a banking AI delegation contract that atomically verifies authority, shared payment caps, and loss coverage while booking recoveries in a single transition, proves cap preservation and recovery feasibility under ordered resource states, and provides paired decision evidence enabling reviewers to assess AI mandate conformance.
